# Awesome AI Agents [![Awesome](https://awesome.re/badge.svg)](https://awesome.re)

> A curated list of AI agent frameworks, tools, and papers.

## Contents

- [Frameworks](#frameworks)
- [Tools](#tools)
- [Papers](#papers)

## Frameworks

- [AgentKit](https://github.com/example/agentkit) — A batteries-included framework for building
  long-horizon agents.
- [Orchestra](https://orchestra.example.com) - Multi-agent orchestration with a declarative DAG.
- [TinyAgent](https://github.com/example/tinyagent) — 400 lines, no dependencies.

## Tools

- [TraceView](https://github.com/example/traceview "Tracing UI") — Span-level tracing for agent runs.
- [EvalHarness](https://github.com/example/evalharness)

  Nested notes about the harness are not entries.

  - [SubEval](https://github.com/example/subeval) — A nested entry, which still counts.

## Usage

Install it like this:

```markdown
- [NotAnEntry](https://github.com/example/not-an-entry) — this lives inside a fenced block
* [AlsoNotAnEntry](https://github.com/example/also-not) — neither is this
```

And with tildes:

~~~
- [StillNotAnEntry](https://github.com/example/still-not) — fenced with tildes
~~~

## Papers

- [Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.11366) — Self-reflection as a learning signal.
- [AgentKit](https://github.com/example/agentkit) — A duplicate of the entry above; first one wins.
